note: Planning registry, NOT an automatic import/install request. CORE, EVALUATE, CONDITIONAL and DEFERRED are documented integration decisions, not claims of existing implementations.

status_definitions.CORE: Required operational capability by the specified milestone; a minimal implementation is sufficient.
status_definitions.EVALUATE: By the specified gate, supply a reproducible baseline comparison or a documented, testable no-go/blocker. Adopt only if incremental value is demonstrated. If data are unavailable, record BLOCKED with requirements and a smallest viable pilot; never silently omit the model.
status_definitions.CONDITIONAL: Explicitly cataloged option whose suitability depends on prerequisites and demonstrated need; no default implementation requirement.
status_definitions.DEFERRED: Explicitly postponed beyond v1.0 or out of the present core scope; requires separate authorization.

models.name: Zero-return prediction / No Trade
models.research_role: Essential null hypothesis and economic control
models.prerequisites: OHLCV

models.name: Linear / Ridge / Logistic Regression
models.research_role: Simple, interpretable predictive baseline
models.prerequisites: Causal tabular features

models.name: Momentum / Mean Reversion / Decision Tree
models.research_role: Rule-based trading baseline; ablations and controls
models.prerequisites: Comparable signals and identical costs

models.name: Random Forest
models.research_role: Tree-based challenger without boosting
models.prerequisites: Causal tabular features

models.name: LightGBM (GBDT)
models.research_role: Fast nonlinear feature and forward-return prediction on CPU
models.prerequisites: Tabular data; sufficient out-of-sample folds

models.name: XGBoost (GBDT)
models.research_role: LightGBM challenger with the same prediction target
models.prerequisites: Comparable tuning and compute budgets

models.name: CatBoost (GBDT)
models.research_role: Alternative when meaningful categorical variables exist
models.prerequisites: Relevant categorical features and research question

models.name: Isolation Forest
models.research_role: Identify unusual market states; NOT alpha by itself
models.baseline: Simple rarity/quantile filters and random events
models.prerequisites: Train-only fit, subsequent-return and cost checks

models.name: PCA and Residual Models
models.research_role: Remove common factors and investigate unusual residuals
models.prerequisites: Several comparable causal time series; train-only fit

models.name: K-Means
models.research_role: Explore state clusters and conditional returns
models.prerequisites: Appropriately scaled features and stable clusters

models.name: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)
models.research_role: Soft-cluster and market-regime probabilities
models.prerequisites: Sufficient sample and stable regimes

models.name: HDBSCAN
models.research_role: Detect rare state clusters and noise points without fixed cluster count
models.prerequisites: Feature scaling, CPU feasibility and cluster stability

models.name: Hidden Markov Models (HMM)
models.research_role: Evaluate latent market regimes and conditional predictive value
models.prerequisites: Chronological fitting/filtering; sufficiently stable regimes

models.name: Autoencoder (small MLP)
models.research_role: Use reconstruction errors and latent features as anomaly hypotheses
models.prerequisites: CPU budget, train-only fit, time-based out-of-sample testing

models.name: LSTM / GRU
models.research_role: Learn sequential dependencies from longer windows
models.baseline: LightGBM on lagged features, Ridge, TCN
models.prerequisites: Enough sequence data and CPU budget

models.name: Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN)
models.research_role: Learn causal sequence features as an alternative to LSTM
models.prerequisites: Train-only scaling and correct window timing

models.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT)
models.research_role: Model multivariate covariates and multi-horizon forecasts
models.prerequisites: A concrete multi-horizon need and sufficient data

models.name: PatchTST
models.research_role: Patch-based time-series transformer representations
models.prerequisites: Longer sequences and sufficient data/compute

models.name: General Time-Series Transformers
models.research_role: Learn temporal representations instead of engineered features
models.prerequisites: Evidence that sequence data justify complexity

models.name: DeepLOB (CNN/LSTM-style architecture)
models.research_role: Limit-order-book representations for short-horizon research
models.prerequisites: High-quality L2/L3 order-book and fill data

models.name: FinBERT
models.research_role: Timestamped financial-news sentiment features
models.prerequisites: Lawfully sourced news, publication lags, model-weight license

models.name: LLM/BERT Embeddings and Structured Text Extraction
models.research_role: Features from news, filings and earnings events
models.baseline: Text categories / sentiment without an LLM
models.prerequisites: Lawful timestamped texts and no future-knowledge leakage

models.name: gpt-oss (local open-weight language models)
models.research_role: Optional local LLM feature extractor, not a required trading agent
models.prerequisites: RAM/compute budget and license/deployment review

models.name: Graph Neural Networks (GNN)
models.research_role: Cross-asset, supply-chain and market-graph dependencies
models.prerequisites: Justified, causally available graph edges

models.name: Model Predictive Control (MPC)
models.research_role: Multi-step decisions subject to position and trading-cost paths
models.prerequisites: Calibrated dynamics and reliable cost model

models.name: Classical Position and Risk Optimization
models.research_role: Optimize net value, risk, no-trade and turnover separately from forecasts
models.prerequisites: Calibrated forecasts, costs and risk budget

models.name: Optuna (Bayesian/TPE-style search)
models.research_role: Budgeted hyperparameter tuning within research folds only
models.prerequisites: Complete trial journal and nested evaluation where necessary

models.name: Multi-Armed Bandits (UCB/Thompson etc.)
models.library: Small custom implementation / optional bandit library
models.research_role: Allocate research budget across exploration and exploitation
models.prerequisites: Reliable, permitted research reward signals

models.name: Successive Halving / Hyperband
models.research_role: Inexpensive screening before expensive experiments
models.baseline: Static scheduler under the same budget
models.prerequisites: Test whether early elimination hides regime-dependent effects

models.name: Columns / Filter-based Strategy Cruncher (Mabe-style)
models.research_role: Generate interpretable rules over broad candidate sets
models.prerequisites: Reasonable seed signal, counted trials and out-of-sample checks

models.name: PPO / SAC / A2C / TD3
models.research_role: Learn trading/execution policies; not a promise of alpha
models.prerequisites: Realistic interaction/replay simulator

models.name: FinRL (RL Trading Framework)
models.research_role: Potential RL research environment, not a default dependency
models.prerequisites: Correct, reproducible simulator
